messages:
Anna K: FYI noticed a latency spike on small-chat embeddings run this morning, region: eu-west-1.
Omar R: saw it too. p95 shot from 42ms -> 220ms around 09:12 UTC
Liam P: pull of metrics points to kernel switch on L4 when batch size >8? kernel name: fast_attn_v2 -> fallback_generic
Anna K: here's the mini-run that reproduces it:
```
# small-chat profile
model: small-chat-7b
q: int8
batch_sizes: [1,4,8,12]
seq: 128
region: eu-west-1
```
Mei W: interesting — T4 didn't have that fallback until batch 24 in our prior tests, right? :thinking_face:
Sanjay G: correct. A10G stays on fast_attn_v3 up to batch 16 then degrades. L4 seems to pick fallback at 9-10.
Ben H: can we rule out KV cache misses? logs show cache_hit_ratio ~0.99
InfraBot: deploy-notice: rolling kernel rollout to eu-west-1 completed at 09:05 UTC
Omar R: timeline suggests new kernel rollout might be the culprit.
Anna K: cost impact for embeddings: L4 unit cost 0.012/token vs A10G 0.019/token — but if latency increases, SLO breaches -> retries -> cost up.
Liam P: quick numbers from today's 1h mini-surge: throughput embeddings (tokens/s): L4 320k -> drop to 140k at spike, T4 stable ~180k, A10G 380k stable
Mei W: small-chat p95: L4 220ms spike, T4 120ms, A10G 95ms
Sanjay G: kernel logs snippet:
```
[09:11:58] kernel_select: model=shell-7b fast_attn_v2 chosen
[09:12:02] batch=10 -> fallback_generic activated, latency_delta=+130ms
```
Anna K: notes: appears triggered when batch mixing (some requests with longer seq) causes per-batch seq variance >16.
Ben H: is batching policy mixing embeddings & chat? That could force larger sequences into same batch.
Omar R: yep, our smart-routing had a cooldown bug; it tried to pack small-chat and embeddings for density.
Anna K: proposed mitigations:
- revert kernel rollout for L4 in eu-west-1
- patch batching policy to honor max_seq variance
- add canary that rejects mixed-type packing
Mei W: and run a targeted replay with batch thresholds 8/12/16 across L4/T4/A10G and quant levels int8/int4
Sanjay G: I'll spin the replay. ETA ~2h. Will dump p95/tps and kernel selects.
Ben H: also capture cost delta: token cost + extra retries
Liam P: for capacity sizing, if L4 degrades at >8 packing we should reduce effective capacity by ~30% for small-chat traffic.
Anna K: agree. Also add an incident note to eng-ml and inform product about potential SLO impact for EU customers.
Omar R: will follow up with kernel-owner (cc @kernel_team).
InfraBot: ticket created: INF-2026 - L4 kernel fallback surge in eu-west-1
Anna K: thanks — keep thread updated with replay results.
